dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Al-jawf Town, Alkufra Governorate, East Province, Libya as of 14 August 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240812LBY** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Al-jawf Town, Alkufra Governorate, East Province, Libya as observed from a Sentinel-2 satellite image acquired on 14 August 2024 at 11:13 UTC. Within the analysed area of about 120km², a total of about 2 km² of lands appear to be affected by flood water. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
